import re

# Regular expression to validate version strings
VERSION_REGEX = re.compile(r'^([0-9]+)\.([0-9]+)\.([0-9]+)$')

def compare_versions(a, b):
    # Validate version strings
    if not VERSION_REGEX.match(a) or not VERSION_REGEX.match(b):
        raise ValueError('Invalid version string format')

    # Split version strings into parts
    parts_a = list(map(int, a.split('.')))
    parts_b = list(map(int, b.split('.'))

    # Compare parts numerically
    for i in range(3):
        if parts_a[i] < parts_b[i]:
            return -1
        elif parts_a[i] > parts_b[i]:
            return 1

    return 0
